subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared selected-versus-resolved model and provider-reported cost contract for `openrouter/auto`, and should this issue remain the user-facing tracker for the combined footer/runtime outcome?
rationale: The missing behavior crosses provider transport, persisted session metadata, agent runtime state, usage templates, transcripts, and footer wording, so automation should not choose the public API shape or tracker split alone.

options.title: Add shared metadata contract
options.body: Capture resolved backend model and provider-cost metadata once, expose it consistently, and keep this issue open until the combined footer/runtime request is satisfied.

options.title: Split across narrower issues
options.body: Make the resolved-model and OpenRouter-cost issues own the lower-level contracts, but only close this issue after their acceptance criteria explicitly cover the combined footer UX.

options.title: Limit to footer display
options.body: Only render routed model and cost in response footers, accepting that runtime and status metadata remain incomplete.

recommendation.title: Add shared metadata contract
recommendation.body: Capture resolved backend model and provider-cost metadata once, expose it consistently, and keep this issue open until the combined footer/runtime request is satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal for the product contract and OpenRouter cost/runtime areas from issue discussion and related commits.
